scope: Secondary post-held-out numerical measurement-noise stress test
heldout84_status: CONSUMED by prior one-shot final validation
fem_source: Existing 84 frozen v1.2 FEM surface-potential fields

frozen_method.active_policy: Voronoi-consistent A-optimal trace in endpoint-x, endpoint-y, depth coordinates

noise_model.type: additive independent zero-mean Gaussian potential noise
noise_model.equation: V_meas = V_FEM + epsilon; epsilon_i ~ N(0, sigma_V^2)
noise_model.sigma_definition: sigma_V = noise_fraction * RMS(V_FEM clean full field) separately for each case
noise_model.common_random_numbers: For a given case/noise level/repetition, the same latent 956-point Gaussian realization is used for Active and Space. Unselected values are never used by acquisition or fitting.

success_criterion.interpretation: Study-specific frozen numerical tolerances, not universal field requirements

reporting.primary: Joint success fraction at N=15 versus measurement-noise level for Active and Space
reporting.paired_metric: Active-minus-Space joint-success difference under common random numbers
reporting.uncertainty: 95% cluster bootstrap confidence intervals over the 84 cases; all Monte Carlo repetitions for a case stay within the resampled cluster
reporting.zero_noise_reference: Use the already disclosed frozen final held-out outputs at N=15; do not reinterpret them as untouched.

freeze_rules: No method, surrogate, seed, inverse-estimator, success-threshold, measurement budget, noise level, Monte Carlo repetition count, or reporting metric may be changed after any noise-stress outcome is viewed.
Behavior-preserving code/runtime fixes are allowed only if documented and do not change the frozen numerical method.
The 84 cases remain consumed. This stress test must never be described as a new independent held-out validation.
Intermediate outcomes must not be used to stop early, add/remove noise levels, or select a favorable operating point.

preflight.purpose: Verify that the copied frozen core reproduces prior zero-noise final outputs before any noisy run.
